source:
@@U02495@@
who dressed themselves in pine branches,
and bellowed riotous songs to all our doom!
O youth, youth,
when will you learn to moderate pleasure?
O Majesty, Majesty,
when will you learn to govern with sense
as great as your power?
Our forest is already afire,
tongues of flame licking upward
to the timbered ceiling, threatening
all the palace with ruin.
Our measure of woe is overfull.
Who is to save us?
All the splendor of Empire
reduced to ashes in a single night.

@@U02497@@
(Removes his mask to reveal himself as 浮士德.)

@@U02498@@
Now we've had enough of terror,
Let rescue come and banish error!
Let our staff make earth resound,
Setting it loudly on the ground!
And you, great, spacious circling air,
Breathe cooling breezes everywhere!
Come, mist and fog and pregnant cloud,
Engulf us in your vaporous shroud!
Drizzling cloudlets, dropping, drenching,
Everywhere fire’s danger quenching,
Turn by your so soothing might
Flames that threaten us with fright
Into summer lightning’s glow,
And put an end to this mocking show!
When spirits threaten us with ill,
It’s time to use our magic skill.
translation:
@@U02495@@
他们穿着松枝，
并高喊着喧闹的歌曲来宣告我们的灭亡！
哦，青年，青年，
你什么时候才能学会节制快乐？
陛下，陛下，
你什么时候才能学会明智地治理
和你的力量一样大吗？
我们的森林已经着火了
火舌向上舔
到木天花板，威胁
整个宫殿一片废墟。
我们对灾难的衡量过度了。
谁来拯救我们？
尽显帝国的辉煌
一夜之间化为灰烬。

@@U02497@@
（摘下面具，露出浮士德的身份。）

@@U02498@@
现在我们已经受够了恐惧
让救援来临，消除错误！
让我们的员工响彻大地，
大声地把它放在地上！
而你，伟大、宽敞的循环空气，
到处呼吸凉爽的微风！
来吧，薄雾和大雾以及怀孕的云彩，
将我们吞没在你的蒸汽裹尸布中！
毛毛细雨，滴落，淋湿，
到处都消除了火灾的危险，
转过你如此舒缓的力量
火焰让我们感到恐惧
进入夏日闪电的光芒，
并结束这场嘲讽表演！
当邪灵以邪恶威胁我们时，
是时候使用我们的魔法技能了。
